svg.aria-label: P3 Dreg per curve and presentation family, n=131
svg.title: P3 Dreg per curve and presentation family, n=131
svg.text: P3 ECC2K-130 analogue, n = 131: Dreg per curve, by presentation family (E0 ringed)
Point = mean over attempts of the per-attempt minimum Dreg over a curve's presentations in that family (recorded dreg; hollow triangle = bound, Dreg >
dmax). x = curve index, 0 = E0; bands = Frobenius orbits. Each family drawn at a small vertical offset for legibility (the value is the point's centre
line). Right strip: random-b curves (arm null, and the nbadapt control).
main: 263/263 curves | stdv: 263/263 curves | badapt: 263/263 curves | bsparse: pending | nbadapt: pending | null: 8 curves
E0 mean Dreg: main 6.00, stdv 6.00, badapt 6.00

right strip: random-b curves (null population and nbadapt control), not curves of the class
Counted metrics (dreg, outcome) are exact; presentations: stdv = standard V in several moduli, badapt = V = span(1,g,..,g^(k-1)) with g adapted to b (E0 borrows
the floor curves' moduli), bsparse and nbadapt as in PROTOCOL section 4. Source data: p3_dreg_n131.data.tsv (pooled recorded rows of p3_ecc2k130/full). A series
with no row in a cell is shown as pending; bounds are never plotted as values.
